answer: Random peer audit defends the agent economy. Each agent is a vertex in the graph: every epoch, three random peers replay that vertex's work and check its signatures. Work climbs three terraces of review, catching copied jobs. Entry needs a $25 bond locked 12 epochs; a failed audit burns it and freezes the vertex 5 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 20,000 fake jobs; an honest agent pays $25 once and earns from the reward oasis.
